q: By June 30, 2027, China's Ministry of Commerce newly places a South Korean company, or a subsidiary at least 50 percent owned by a South Korean company, on the export control list, the Unreliable Entity List, the countermeasure list under the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law, or a list under State Council Decree No. 835; or the suspension of sanctions on Hanwha Ocean's subsidiaries is not extended and the sanctions take effect again (excluded if the lapse is merely a technical gap and the suspension is renewed within 30 days)
basis: Toward South Korea as a whole, China's default is to court it, but it readily imposes targeted sanctions on companies that cooperate with the United States (the October 2025 sanctions on Hanwha Ocean's subsidiaries). The suspension of the Hanwha Ocean sanctions ends on November 10, 2026, and it has not been confirmed whether it was extended along with the truce. Listings are also becoming more frequent, as with the addition of 10 U.S. companies in June 2026. · AI and Chips issue
rs: Notices by China's Ministry of Commerce
